about.title: The duck behind the pond
about.subtitle: Curran Hill · Cybersecurity student at the University of Texas at San Antonio.
about.body:
I’m Curran, a cybersecurity student at UTSA. This pond is where I document what I’m learning and working on, from [Hack The Box machines](/htb.html) to [CTF challenges](/ctf.html) and [notes along the way](/blog.html).

I enjoy following a thread, figuring out how things work, and writing down the path so someone else can follow it too.

awards.title: CTF@CIT Top 5
awards.body: Competed against 752 international teams and placed 5th worldwide.

awards.title: UND CyberHawks Finalist
awards.body: Competed against 216 teams across the U.S. in the qualifying round, placing 14th.

awards.title: Hack The Madness Sweet 16
awards.body: Competed in a March Madness style tournament, making it to the Sweet 16.

awards.title: UND CyberHawks Finalist
awards.body: Competed against 90+ teams from all over the U.S. and qualified for finals.
